row.rowText: Proportion Of Waste Collected And Managed In Authorised Facilities Out Of Total Waste Generated
row.footnote: Data are used for SDG 11.6.1 'Proportion of municipal solid waste collected and managed in controlled facilities out of total municipal waste generated, by cities'.

row.rowText: Quantity Of Hazardous Waste Generated Per Capita
row.footnote: Data are based on records of hazardous waste being collected and treated.  Data are used for SDG 12.4.2 '(a) Hazardous waste generated per capita; and (b) Proportion of hazardous waste treated, by type of treatment'.

row.rowText: Proportion Of Generated Hazardous Waste Treated
row.footnote: Data are based on records of hazardous waste being collected and treated.  Data are used for SDG 12.4.2 '(a) Hazardous waste generated per capita; and (b) Proportion of hazardous waste treated, by type of treatment'.
